result.summary: The page is generally polished, but the active navigation state is inconsistent with the displayed content, and several horizontally scrolling elements are visibly clipped at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The Profile tab is highlighted in green even though the screen displays the restaurant discovery/home feed. The Home tab appears inactive, creating a mismatch between the selected navigation state and the current page.
issues.suggestion: Highlight Home for this feed, or display the Profile screen if Profile is intended to be the active destination.

issues.description: The category chip row ends with a partially visible, cut-off chip on the right edge, making the layout look accidentally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add a deliberate carousel affordance or padding, or ensure the next chip is fully visible within the viewport.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel shows the third card cut off at the right edge, including truncated restaurant text.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel spacing and clipping with a visible peek of the next card, or provide horizontal scrolling cues.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation reaches directly over the lower restaurant card, leaving the card visibly cut off behind the navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation bar height so cards can scroll fully above the fixed navigation.
